purpose: Unified development knowledge library (six domains) plus the local developer toolkit

domains.title: PortableApps.com packaging
domains.covers: PortableApps.com format, Launcher + Installer INI, packaging workflow, updating, failure modes, submission

domains.title: World of Warcraft addon development
domains.covers: Addon anatomy, Lua, API/events/widgets, flavors + interface numbers (Forever first, interface 16001), libraries, packaging

domains.title: Kotlin Android apps and games
domains.covers: Kotlin, Compose, architecture, Room, coroutines, testing, Play release, billing, games (Compose Canvas, libGDX, native graphics)

domains.title: Godot for Android games and apps
domains.covers: Godot engine versions, project anatomy, Android export pipeline, Google Play, plugins, testing/CI, permissions Plus the nine Godot editor addons as a complete project in godot/toolbox/.

domains.title: Windows desktop development system
domains.covers: Rule layers (Elite Prompt, Engineering Contract V4.0, guardrails), tiers + sanctioned stacks, QUALITY.md gate, SeanPak packaging, TesselGUI design, release verification
domains.note: Already in this repo before the 2026-11-18 merge; its manifest lists its files.

domains.title: Flutter development pack
domains.covers: Toolchain, Dart, widgets/UI, state, navigation, networking, storage, testing, Windows desktop, Android release, flavors, performance, architecture
domains.note: Already in this repo before the 2026-11-18 merge; its manifest lists its files.

domains.title: AI development resource index
domains.covers: Curated pointers to toolchains, MCP servers, agent frameworks, local inference, models/providers, RAG, eval, coding agents, ML libraries, learning references

domains.title: ForAI resource library
domains.covers: Curated dev-resource library: categories, catalogs (incl. Windows development repositories), resources.json/csv, llms.txt + llms-full.txt; its own AI_INDEX.md is the file map

domains.title: WinDevKit shared development resources
domains.covers: Windows dev kits + crates, bindings, templates, schemas, tools; docs/CATALOG.md is the file map
